header: Conﬁguring Agentic Search with Bedrock Claude
content:
Agentic search leverages autonomous agents to execute complex searches on your behalf by
understanding user intent, orchestrating the right tools, generating optimized queries, and
providing transparent summaries of their decisions through a natural language interface. These
agents are powered by reasoning models, such as Bedrock Claude.
Follow the steps below to open and run a CloudFormation template that automatically conﬁgures
Bedrock Claude models for agentic search, and how to conﬁgure and create your agents in the AI
Search Flows plugin on OpenSearch Dashboards.
